subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Eric realized the fair was like pocket money.”?
options: He knew that something short can still be beautiful.
Having fun is good, but choices still matter.
Changing habits requires systems that make better choices possible, not just good intentions.
Good care asks for consent, not just compliance.
